conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: I’m so stressed! My loan account’s marked NPA, but I’ve been paying!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: That’s concerning Sir. Can you confirm your loan account number?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: It’s two four five, three one six, seven seven eight. This could ruin my credit score!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I see the issue. A payment was missed due to a bank error. I’ll correct the NPA status.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Please fix it fast! I’m really worried about this.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: It’s corrected Sir. Your account is clear, and I’ll ensure it’s reported to CIBIL.
